core_obligations: Closed envelope: finite-type-closed-in-fp gives a closed immersion X -> X' over S with X' of finite presentation over S.
Finite-level model: descend-finite-presentation gives an i and a finite presentation morphism X'_i -> S_i whose pullback is X'; set W = X'_i.
Conclusion: X -> S x_{S_i} W = X' is the closed immersion from the envelope (base change along S -> S_i).
proof_roadmap: Closed immersion into an fp scheme over S.
Descend the fp scheme to a finite level.
Identify the square; closed immersion by base change.
difficulty_reason: Closed envelope via finite-type-closed-in-fp; descend-finite-presentation gives the finite-level model X'_i -> S_i; the closed immersion is preserved by base change. Two engines plus the base-change observation.
